_note: MINERVA's target lists in their Google Sheet, read by robofast_core.catalogs.minerva_sheet (docs/minerva_sheet.md):
Copy this file to the control host and fill in the placeholders there; never commit the real values.
key_file: MINERVA's Google service-account key (JSON), mode 600, outside any repository. $ROBOFAST_MINERVA_SHEETS_KEY overrides it.
sheet: each list's spreadsheet key (the long id in the Sheet's URL; legacy minerva-control has it in
minerva_library/targetlist.py downloadList). The red-side list is a sheet of its own; it is disabled
here until it is confirmed to be wanted and an instrument_type exists for it.
snapshot_dir: omitted, snapshots go to $ROBOFAST_DATA_DIR/minerva_sheet (robofast_core.zenodo.data_dir); keep: how many.

targets.sheet: <spreadsheet key of the MINERVA target list>

bstars.sheet: <spreadsheet key of the MINERVA target list>

red.sheet: <spreadsheet key of the red-side target list>
